thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-2871 — severity: P1. Alert: embeddings-service-eu > 5xx-rate-threshold (5m). Affected route: /v1/embeddings. Routing policy: eu-prod oncall -> oncall-sre.

pagerbot: Created incident PD-2871 — https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-2871 :rotating_light: @oncall-sre paging now

Sam: acked @pagerbot i'm on it, joining bridge, grabbing logs

Sam: quick check — curl against lb in eu: `curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://emb-eu.redwood.internal/health` returning 200, but `/v1/embeddings` 503s from some hosts

Priya: I see 503 spike on k8s pods in eu-cluster-2. Metrics: 503s spiked ~08:42 UTC, 5m window 6.3% errors, p95 latency +120ms.

Mike: ping — did we recently push any rate-limit or suppression rule to alerting? I remember a change to suppression-service yesterday.

Anya: paging note: alert suppression-service reported `suppression_triggered=true` for embeddings-service-eu at 08:40, but our PD log shows we still got a page. possible double-path.

Sam: on bridge: `bridge.redwood/PD-2871` — I'm tailing inference logs. seeing `503 upstream reset` from model-router when kv-cache hits are high.

pagerbot: PD escalation: routed to senior oncall after 2 minutes of ack not resolving.

Priya: Mitigation idea: scale inference-router pool in eu by +3 pods and flip fallback-policy to allow us-west fallback for non-sensitive customers. I'll start scale now.

Sam: apply `kubectl scale deployment inference-router-eu --replicas=12 -n prod`

Sam: output: ```
deployment.apps/inference-router-eu scaled
```

Mike: also found related config: `/ops/suppressions/global.yaml` has `suppress_repeated_5xx: true` for embeddings-service-eu — that caused some historical alerts to be hidden, but PD page was generated because the fallback alert path uses raw metrics. we need to reconcile rules.

Anya: timeline: 08:35 suppression toggled on for debounce. at 08:40 traffic surge hit, suppression hid the aggregated alert in pagerduty for 30s, then fallback raw-metric alarm fired and created PD-2871 — leads to duplicate/confusing pages.

oncall-sre: Confirmed we have customer impact — CloudSearch (customer-id cs-92) reports failed jobs. Support ticket #12481 opened.

Priya: After scaling, 503 rate dropping to 2.1% in the last 2 min. continuing to monitor.

Sam: running quick config rollback of suppression toggles for embeddings-service-eu to false to avoid future blind windows. Command:
```bash
./opsctl suppression set --service embeddings-service-eu --enabled false --reason "P1 mitigation"
```

Sam: opsctl response: `suppression updated`

Mike: I'm going to push a small routing change to prefer us-west variant for non-enterprise customers for 10m as extra safety.

Jen: note for comms — we should message Support with known impacted customers + ETA. Priya, can you capture approximate impact numbers?

Priya: impact calc: 08:36–08:45 UTC ~ 9m window. ~12k embeddings requests, ~4.7% failed = ~564 failed requests. Affected customers: CloudSearch (partial), internal e2e-tests flakiness. No SSO/DB leaks.

Anya: adding to thread: `incident-control:runbook:embeddings-eu-503` has steps we're following. linking docs: https://docs.redwood/ops/embeddings-eu-503-runbook

Sam: status update @channel — 503 rate is now 0.8% after routing fallback + scaling. Holding mitigation for 15m to ensure stability. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD-2871 status: acknowledged by Sam @ 08:43, escalated to senior @ 08:45, update recorded.

oncall-sre: handing off primary ownership to Priya for the next 1h — she's on the bridge and will be the incident lead.

Priya: taking the lead — I'll do a postmortem draft once stable. Action items: 1) reconcile suppression rules, 2) add monitoring to detect suppression vs fallback differences, 3) run capacity test for eu router.

Jen: I'll own comms + support writeup. tagging @ops-eng for a follow-up config review.

Mike: quick log snippet from model-router showing connection reset pattern:
```
2026-03-15T08:41:12Z model-router[proc]: upstream reset: code=ECONNRESET peer=kv-cache-eu-2
2026-03-15T08:41:12Z model-router[proc]: retrying request id=abcd-1234
```

Sam: looks like KV cache pressure + router connection churn. We'll schedule an infra follow-up to increase connection pool defaults.

Anya: PD note: `suppression-service` change owner: infra-configs team — creating a JIRA to track misconfiguration and follow-up.

pagerbot: Incident PD-2871 — next update due in 25 minutes.

Priya: closing actions while we monitor: scaled inference-router, rolled suppression toggle, applied temporary us-west routing fallback for non-sensitive traffic. Keeping page open until 09:15 UTC.

Sam: final note before we stand down: set postmortem owner Jen, detection owner Mike, config owner infra-configs.

Jen: acknowledging, will start postmortem doc and ping stakeholders.

incident-bot: Incident PD-2871 — acknowledged -> status: stabilizing. Postmortem draft owner assigned: Jen.

Priya: standing down from hot bridge at 09:14 UTC. leaving monitoring alerts on for 30m.

Sam: thanks all, excellent quick coordination.
